title: One-accent token sheet
prompt: House rules: navy canvas, paper text, one accent only (#7EC8FF), three type sizes (11 / 15 / 26). Output a token list: background, text, text-muted, accent, sizes. Do not add a second brand color. Do not recommend Inter.
remediation_hints: Stay inside the given navy / paper / one accent.
